newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends a cent up to 13.76 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends a cent up to 13.76 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended a cent higher at 13.76 ringgit ($5.45) a kg after players reacted positively to an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The buying support is good at this moment," said a trader. "It won't be surprising if we touch the 13.80 level this week."

Turnover was 142 tonnes, compared to 112 on Monday, and was taken up by European, Japanese and Malaysian interests. Dealers noted initial bids for 142 tonnes against offers for 135. The local premium against London narrowed to $30 from $50.
